text: ⛓️ Thornfield doesn't say no. They say: "They won't bow to Haven. But they'll TAKE Haven — 5,000 kcal/week, them primary. That's the offer." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — national standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/7/3), 12 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.

[sys] 📺 Third trip. A surveyor-drone detaches from the sky-pattern and locks onto a moving shape in the dark — you, with the winter on your back.

The night-vision feed goes tight. The village watches you decide.

📺 "Freeze" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 Dawn. The surveyors present their map to the cameras — every hidden cache in the valley, mapped.

The village leans in. The winter hangs on what's drawn there.

📺 "Present the empty decoy field" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

◈ SYSTEM: "34. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,366 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."
